pairs.subject: image-to-3d-input-gating
pairs.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_vlm_critique.py:63 This script defines the SCORE/DEFECTS/VERDICT reply contract that the repo's image-to-3D input gate says it shares (input-gate.ts:25), but it asks for free-text defects and a prose verdict sentence where the standard requires a closed defect vocabulary and a verdict token from a closed set, so defect classes cannot be counted across a batch.

techniques.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_vlm_critique.py:63 DEFECTS is open 'comma-separated visual problems' and VERDICT is a sentence. Both are named as failures by the technique. The rest is right: the integer scale is stated, and a missing score is an error (POF_VLM_ERROR), not a pass.

pairs.registryProposal: The technique could say outright whether an output critic that defines a protocol an input gate inherits falls under the closed-vocabulary rule. The subject defers output acceptance to a sibling subject, but here the shared contract came from the output side.

pairs.subject: image-to-3d-input-gating
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/useForgeStore.ts:20 The forge can only submit text or one reference image, never a view set, even though the generate route accepts multiview-to-3d with front/left/back/right views; and its 2D→3D handoff passes the exact 2D image on with no brief that strips lettering. So a character is always reconstructed from the master view alone, and symbolic content gets to the paid stage unchecked.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/useForgeStore.ts:20 There is no multiview mode or view slots on the client, though route.ts accepts viewDataUrls for multiview-to-3d. A character never gets the front+back views the technique calls highest-return.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/Image2DPanel.tsx:112 A 2D image made from a free prompt is staged as-is for reconstruction, with no text-free brief or stripping step. The 'no lettering' clause exists only in contact-sheet.ts (icon sets), and the server input-gate criteria do not list lettering either.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/GenerationPanel.tsx:294 The forge carries the gate's note (ran/unavailable/skipped) onto the job (useForgeStore inputGateNote) and shows it verbatim, so an ungated submit never reads as a pass. This verdict covers the in-context reporting only; see notes for the middle-band leak in the route.
src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/useForgeStore.ts:106 ForgeReference holds a single image, and single-reference reconstructions are the technique's own stated exception.
src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/referenceHandoff.ts:87 The forge has no scene-decompose mode. One reference means one asset.
